decision.reason: The source is a bounded, openly accessible chat corpus with prompt and assistant-message fields and broad instruction/dialogue coverage. It is small enough for a streaming first experiment.

candidates.approximate_size: train_sft is about 208k examples; the dataset card reports 207,865
candidates.response_provenance: The dataset card describes ChatGPT-generated multi-turn dialogues; individual response provenance is not represented as a per-example model field.
candidates.domains: Broad instruction and dialogue topics; no guaranteed mapping to the project's Code/Reasoning/Instruction domains.
candidates.license_usage_metadata: Hugging Face card metadata says MIT.
candidates.redistribution_commercial_use: Card metadata appears permissive, but upstream prompt and model-output rights are not independently verified; this report is not legal clearance.
candidates.contamination_risk: High enough to require exact, lexical, and fuzzy prompt checks against all 900 canonical prompts before sampling.
candidates.first_experiment_scope: Pinned train_sft revision only; screen all rows, then deterministically sample up to 50,000 clean examples. Do not read train_sft test split.

candidates.approximate_size: 939,344 examples; dataset card reports about 1.4 GB download and 2.9 GB uncompressed
candidates.response_provenance: A multi-source SFT mixture used for Tulu 3; per-source names are provided.
candidates.domains: Math, GSM, Python, algebra, instruction following, science, multilingual, and general dialogue among other subsets.
candidates.license_usage_metadata: Top-level ODC-BY-1.0; the card explicitly says subset licenses differ and includes CC-BY-NC-4.0 No Robots plus third-party model-output terms.
candidates.redistribution_commercial_use: Some components are noncommercial or have separate third-party terms; unsuitable as a single undifferentiated first source without subset-level review.
candidates.contamination_risk: High; includes benchmark-like math, code, and instruction subsets, so the same all-900 prompt filter would be mandatory.

candidates.approximate_size: About 1.0 million conversations (approximately 1.94 GB on the dataset page)
candidates.response_provenance: A compiled synthetic instruction/chat collection with multiple upstream sources and model-generated responses; per-example provenance is mixed.
candidates.domains: General instruction, reasoning, code, and synthetic dialogue from multiple component datasets.
candidates.license_usage_metadata: The dataset page does not provide a clear overall license statement; a dataset discussion flags GPT-output and upstream licensing concerns.
candidates.redistribution_commercial_use: Unclear; excluded from the first sourcebook pending source-level rights review.
candidates.contamination_risk: High due to mixed upstream benchmark and instruction corpora.

methodology_constraints.decontamination_input: Canonical prompt text, IDs, and domains only.
methodology_constraints.heldout_response_overlap: Not measured by design; held-out responses are forbidden filtering inputs.
